//exclude: The frozen Next.js app is the only thing here TypeScript owns.
supabase/ is Deno, with its own config and its own type check in
scripts/qa/run-edge-function-tests.sh; its jsr: and https: imports are
unresolvable to Next by design, and including them is what has been
failing the Vercel build. artifacts/ and .build/ are build output —
gitignored, so Vercel never sees them, but they carry vendored Deno
examples that break a local `tsc` run for the same reason.
